reviewNotes: Unified remaining-work source review: record 63 静 -> 靜, record 67 奈々 -> 奈奈 and record 72 岩鉄 -> 岩鐵. These are fixed one- or two-cell labels; preserve all other source names, player-customized storage and default animal handling. These three additions are not yet included in a released ROM.

This does not change suggested-name copying, keyboard mappings, default animal labels or player-customized name storage; natural nickname callers remain a separate verification requirement.
